national_news.title: MEA Highlights Nepal Flood Rescue, Greater Malé Connectivity Project, and Ukraine Diplomacy
bullets: The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) confirmed that 166 Indian nationals have been rescued in flood-hit Nepal, with India planning to supply Bailey bridges and forensic kits to aid relief efforts.
The first segment of the India-assisted Greater Malé Connectivity Project (GMCP), which links capital Malé with three adjoining islands in the Maldives, has been completed.

External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar visited Kyiv to meet Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, emphasizing India's position that solutions to conflicts must emerge through dialogue and diplomacy rather than the battlefield.

national_news.title: Meghalaya Hosts 5th Sohra International Half Marathon 2026
bullets: The 5th Sohra International Half Marathon was organized by the Meghalaya State Olympics Association (MSOA) and the Directorate of Sports and Youth Affairs, drawing 11,672 participants.
Satish Kumar Verma won the Elite Men’s 21 km category in 1:03:04, while Tejaswini Narendra Lambkane secured the Elite Women’s title in 1:15:20.
The event, recognized by the Athletics Federation of India (AFI), aimed to position Meghalaya as a major sports and eco-tourism hub.

national_news.title: Inaugural Drass District Festival Organized in Ladakh for Eco-Tourism
bullets: The first-ever two-day Drass District Festival was inaugurated in Ladakh by Deputy Commissioner Kacho Imtiyaz Ahmed to boost cultural and eco-tourism.
A special Nature Trail was organized across the Drass and Mushkoh valleys to raise awareness about the fragile local ecosystem and the conservation of the endangered Himalayan Brown Bear.
The festival integrated traditional sports like Horse Polo alongside cultural displays to encourage sustainable tourism and local artisan livelihoods.

national_news.title: NAMASTE Cards Distributed to Waste Pickers Under Central Sanitation Scheme
bullets: Union Minister of State for Social Justice and Empowerment inaugurated the issuance of National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE) Cards and Ayushman Cards to waste pickers.
NAMASTE is a Central Sector Scheme implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment to ensure safety, formal recognition, and socio-economic upliftment of sanitation workers.
The initiative aims to eliminate hazardous manual cleaning through mechanisation, skill development, and providing social security and healthcare benefits.

national_news.title: CSIR-IIIM Highlights Biotech Startups and Agri-Missions at IBTP Kathua
bullets: The Industrial Biotech Park (IBTP) at Kathua, J&K, operated under CSIR-IIIM Jammu, serves as a hub for translating scientific research into commercial and field-level applications.

IBTP houses the BioNEST Bioincubation Centre and a Centre of Excellence (CoE) that provide technical mentorship, product testing, and infrastructure to technology startups in biotechnology, agriculture, nutrition, and health.

CSIR-IIIM is actively driving rural empowerment through national initiatives including the CSIR Aroma Mission and Floriculture Mission, aiding farmers with scientific guidance in cultivating medicinal and aromatic plants.

national_news.title: Union Minister Calls for Nationwide Outreach to Maximize Free Trade Agreement Utilisation
bullets: Union Minister Piyush Goyal launched a nationwide FTA utilisation outreach campaign at a National Workshop in New Delhi, aiming to extend trade benefits across all 780 districts to MSMEs, startups, and women entrepreneurs.
India currently holds 9 Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) covering economies with a combined GDP of around $60 trillion, providing preferential access to nearly two-thirds of global trade.
India's cumulative exports during April–July reached approximately $317 billion, up by $36–37 billion year-on-year, supporting India's long-term vision of becoming a $30 trillion economy by 2047.

national_news.title: India to Appoint Defence Attaché to Brussels During Belgian PM's Visit
bullets: India announced the appointment of a Defence Attaché to Brussels, complementing Belgium's placement of a Defence Attaché in New Delhi earlier in the year.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever set a target to double bilateral trade from the current 13 billion USD over the next five years.
Key discussions focused on 'Trade, Technology, and Talent' (3 Ts), with PM Modi inviting Belgian academic institutions to establish campuses in India and participate in WAVES 2.0.

national_news.title: EAM S. Jaishankar Holds High-Level Bilateral Talks in Kyiv, Ukraine
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar met Ukrainian counterpart Andrii Sybiha and President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Kyiv during an official visit to Ukraine and Poland.
India highlighted that it has supplied 19 consignments amounting to 160 tonnes of humanitarian assistance to Ukraine, including generator sets and medical supplies.
EAM emphasized the need to protect commercial shipping and seafarers, noting how disruptions affect fuel, food, and fertilizer security across the Global South.

national_news.title: Ukraine Welcomes India's Diplomatic Push for Conflict Resolution
bullets: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha welcomed the first-ever dedicated bilateral visit of an Indian External Affairs Minister to Ukraine.
Both nations focused on restoring freedom of navigation in the Black Sea, global food security, and bilateral expansion in pharmaceuticals and digital innovation.
Kyiv expressed appreciation for Prime Minister Narendra Modi's dialogue-first peace calls conveyed during the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek.

national_news.title: India and Belgium Sign MoUs on Defence, Cybercrime, and Launch Strategic Dialogue
bullets: India and Belgium formally launched the India-Belgium Strategic Dialogue and signed a Letter of Intent (LoI) to deepen defence-industrial partnerships and military training.
A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was signed between India's Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) and the Federal Police of Belgium to combat cybercrime and transnational organized crime.
Belgium reaffirmed its support for India's candidature for permanent membership in a reformed United Nations Security Council (UNSC) and called for early implementation of the India-EU FTA.

national_news.title: Union Minister Piyush Goyal Urges Nationwide FTA Utilisation Drive
bullets: Union Minister of Commerce & Industry Piyush Goyal launched a nationwide drive at the 'Leveraging FTAs an Outreach Programme' workshop in New Delhi to maximize Free Trade Agreement (FTA) utilization across 780 districts.
India's nine FTAs currently span economies totaling nearly $60 trillion in GDP, offering preferential market access to almost two-thirds of global trade.
India's exports reached approximately $317 billion between April and July, registering a growth of $36-37 billion over the same period in the previous year.

national_news.title: EAM S. Jaishankar Visits Ukraine, Reaffirms Support for Peaceful Resolution
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar met Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha and President Volodymyr Zelenskyy during a three-day visit to Ukraine and Poland.
India stressed the impact of ongoing commercial shipping attacks on Global South supply chains, notably fuel, fertilizer, and food shortages.
India has dispatched 19 consignments of humanitarian aid totaling 160 tonnes to Ukraine, including generator sets, medicines, and medical equipment.

bihar_news.title: RVNL Bags ₹903-Crore Railway Infrastructure Order for Buxar Thermal Power Project
bullets: Navratna PSU Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd (RVNL) received a ₹903 crore Letter of Award from SJVN Thermal Private Limited for infrastructure work at the 1,320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project in Bihar.
The project includes constructing a permanent railway siding and aerial connection from the plant boundary to Chausa and Pawani Kamarpur under Phase III, with a 36-month execution timeline.
SJVN Thermal Private Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of SJVN Limited, a joint venture under the Ministry of Power.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Promotes Aquaculture Insurance Under PM-MKSSY Scheme
bullets: Bihar is promoting aquaculture insurance under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-Yojana (PM-MKSSY), providing a 40% one-time premium incentive up to ₹1 lakh, with SC, ST, and women receiving an additional 10% incentive (up to ₹1.10 lakh).
The insurance coverage offers protection up to ₹20 lakh against floods, pollution, and drought across ponds, RAS, bio-floc, and raceway systems based on ₹25,000 per hectare for up to 4 hectares.
PM-MKSSY is a Central Sector Sub-scheme under PMMSY with an outlay of ₹6,000 crore (50% public finance including World Bank/AFD loans) running from FY 2023-24 to FY 2026-27.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Commits ₹1.38 Lakh Crore to Achieve 24 GW Renewable Energy Target by 2030
bullets: Bihar has committed ₹1.38 lakh crore to scale up its renewable energy (RE) capacity to 24 GW along with 6 GWh of energy storage capacity by 2030.
As of 2026, Bihar's total installed renewable capacity stands at 709.30 MW, increasing from 194 MW in 2016 and 365.09 MW in 2020.
In comparison, India's leading state Karnataka currently holds 27,442 MW of installed renewable capacity and aims for 66 GW by 2030.

bihar_news.title: Heavy Industries Ministry Receives Bids for $7.74 Billion Rare-Earth Permanent Magnet Scheme
bullets: The Ministry of Heavy Industries received 20 bids for establishing integrated rare-earth permanent magnet (REPM) manufacturing facilities in India.
The $7.74 billion REPM scheme aims to create 6,000 metric tonnes per annum (MTPA) of capacity, allocating up to 1,200 MTPA to each of up to 5 beneficiaries via global bidding.
Key participating firms include Coal India, L&T, ReNew, Attero Recycling, and Lohum Magnets to develop end-to-end processing from NdPr oxide to finished magnets.

bihar_news.title: Gandak Barrage Shields Bihar From Himalayan Flood Surge
bullets: Engineers opened all 36 gates of the 57-year-old Gandak Barrage at Valmikinagar in West Champaran, releasing nearly 1.5 lakh cusecs of floodwater to control a massive surge from Nepal.
The incoming floodwaters surged from Nepal's Trishuli and Narayani river systems into India as the Gandak River, threatening large parts of northern Bihar.
The Gandak Barrage was constructed following the 1959 Gandak Agreement between India and Nepal to regulate water flow, prevent catastrophic flooding, and support regional irrigation.

bihar_news.title: India's Foodgrain Production Estimated at Record 376.5 Million Tonnes for 2025-26
bullets: According to the Third Advance Estimates (2025-26), India's total foodgrain production is estimated at 376.563 million tonnes, representing a 5.3% (18.8 million tonnes) rise from 357.732 million tonnes in the previous year.

Under the Decentralised Grain Storage Plan in Cooperative Sector launched in 2023, godown construction was completed in 313 Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), creating over 1.80 LMT of storage capacity by July 2026.
The decentralised storage framework aims to strengthen food security under NFSA 2013, mitigate foodgrain wastage, cut transportation costs, and prevent distress sales by farmers.

bihar_news.title: Riga Sugar Mill in Sitamarhi Introduces QR-Based Token System for Cane Procurement
bullets: Riga Sugar Mill located in Bihar's Sitamarhi district is introducing an unmanned electronic weighing system with digital QR-code tokens for sugarcane procurement.
The initiative aims to enhance transparency during the crushing season, addressing demands raised by the Sugarcane Producers Association.
Farmers' demands during the review meeting included a minimum sugarcane price of Rs 650 per quintal and adherence to mandatory 14-day payment rules under the Cane Act.
